verdict.rationale: The only wearable evidence is the FAQ saying you can mirror Authenticator notifications from your phone to a wearable device. That covers sign-in notifications on the watch, not reading one-time codes there, so it gives only glancing support for the story. Missing for 10: a native smartwatch app or complication that shows OTP codes, documentation of which watch platforms are supported, and independent or hands-on confirmation of using it on a watch.
